message: As a parent, I know how easy it is to get wrapped up in the daily hustle and forget about fire safety at home. But it’s super helpful to have a game plan in mind—especially when kids are involved! I found a great resource that lays out what to do in case of a fire, and it’s perfect for involving the whole family in the conversation. 🏠 Just remember, practicing safety can be as fun as a family game night! How do you talk about safety with your kids?
